evidence.text: A widely forwarded post cites 'Cedar Institute (2026)' for a sleep-aid breakthrough.
An aggregator's note says the debunking comment was auto-removed by a spam filter.
The cited journal's index has no such article.
Cedar Institute's 2026 program lists no such trial.
The assay lab's report flags the sample as contaminated.
A second lab reproduces the contamination finding.
A supplier newsletter touts the batch as premium grade.
A comment thread claims both labs used expired reagents; no lot numbers are given.
A talk-show segment cites 'Harbor Clinic (2026)' for a migraine device.
The device registry has no listing under that name.
Harbor Clinic's site lists no such device trial.
A reposted thread insists the registry lookup used the wrong spelling.
A sponsored article claims the dam's spillway was upgraded in 2026.
A channel description says the inspection video was taken down for music copyright.
The engineering firm's report lists no 2026 spillway work.
Satellite imagery from 2026 shows the old spillway.
The title search finds a prior lien on the property.
The county recorder confirms the lien filing.
The seller's brochure describes the title as clear.
An anonymous email claims the lien was released last month; no release is recorded.
A podcast cites 'Northgate (2026)' for a battery breakthrough.
A newsletter repeats the podcast's claim.
The patent office has no filing matching the description.
Northgate's research page lists no battery program.
A forum reply says the patent search missed a foreign filing; no number is given.
The meter log records the reading.
The technician's worksheet matches the log.
The contract's clause 9 bars the assignment.
Counsel's memo confirms the bar applies.
